# Grug Digital

> Grug Digital has three sections: free browser games and an avatar maker for players, an avatar studio that AI agents
> can drive for game developers, and free tools for restaurants. The home page (https://grugdigital.com/) is the directory.
> The old site is still served at its old paths.

## For game developers and their AI agents

- [Avatar Studio for agents](https://grugdigital.com/agents/studio/): a browser app (WebGL) that makes a blocky Roblox
  R6 character: hair, a face, a custom shirt and pants painted with an AI image editor (Gemini / Nano Banana), and a
  rigged `.glb` download. This version has no pickers or sliders: the page shows the three steps and what to do next, and
  `window.GrugStudio` does everything from code.
- [Guide for Claude and other AI agents](https://grugdigital.com/agents/studio/claude.md): how to make a character for
  someone who pasted the studio's link into a chat, step by step, including the `window.GrugStudio` JavaScript API and
  recipe links (`/agents/studio/?hair=…&outfit=…`) for when you can't use a browser.
- [Grug for agents](https://grugdigital.com/agents/): prompts to copy and send to an agent, the Claude skill and links
  to the source on GitHub.
- [Claude skill (zip)](https://grugdigital.com/character/roblox-characters.zip): install it so Claude uses the studio
  whenever a Roblox game needs characters or NPCs, and brings them into the game.
- [Asset packs](https://grugdigital.com/packs/): low-poly 3D packs (avatar accessories, characters, pets, game kits),
  sold on [itch.io](https://polysw.itch.io/). [The list as JSON](https://grugdigital.com/api/itch-assets): every pack with
  its price, description, cover and itch link, grouped into categories.

## For players

- [Grug Arcade](https://grugdigital.com/arcade/): free blocky games that run in the browser.
- [Avatar Studio](https://grugdigital.com/character/): the same studio made for people (kids and hobbyists): tabs, a
  wardrobe, Back and Next. A character saved here is the one they play as in the games. `window.GrugStudio` works here
  too, but agents should use the agents' version above.

## For restaurants

- [Grug for restaurants](https://grugdigital.com/restaurants/): a free rewards (stamp) card, a one-page website made
  from it, and a dashboard for schedules, checklists, temperatures and recipe costs.

## Retired

- The Building Studio (`/build/`), its guide and its `game-buildings` skill were retired in November 2026. There is no
  building tool on the site.
